map.线性尺寸链最坏累积 = 各环公差绝对值之和。: Worst-case accumulation of a linear dimension chain = the sum of the absolute tolerances of all links.
map.统计法可用 RSS 替代。: A statistical approach can use RSS instead.
map.总公差 = sum(|t_i|)（线性叠加）。例：三件公差 ±0.05、±0.0: Total tolerance = sum(|t_i|) (linear addition). Example: three parts at ±0.05, ±0.03 and ±0.02 give ±0.10 mm overall.
map.最坏累积=0.12+0.05+0.08+0.03=0.280 mm，平均单环 0: Worst-case accumulation = 0.12+0.05+0.08+0.03 = 0.280 mm, an average of 0.070 mm per link. Negative tolerances enter as absolute values, so the result is the most conservative estimate.
map.最坏叠加保守，RSS（平方和根）统计更紧，按风险选。: Worst-case stacking is conservative, while RSS (root sum square) is statistically tighter; choose by risk.
map.关键配合、安全件取最坏情况。: Critical fits and safety parts take the worst case.
